documents.title: PRIMARY POISONING ENTRY
documents.text: Patient: John McClane. Treatment entry predates the transport flight. Poisoning treatment is recorded. The circumstances and specimen-related incident material are cross-referenced under INC-P17. Those incident attachments are not held in this clinical folder. This entry does not identify a perpetrator.

documents.title: PRIMARY GUNSHOT ENTRY
documents.text: Patient: John McClane. Gunshot treatment entry predates the transport flight. Related incident material, including the projectile examination reference, is cross-referenced under INC-G04. That material is not a clinical finding identifying who fired the weapon.

documents.title: ATTACHMENT REGISTER
documents.text: The clinical summary omitted the external attachment references. INC-P17 and INC-G04 belong to the incident files, not the medical cabinet. Request those two files through the incident-records enquiry. Possession of the medical entries is not a finding of guilt.

conclusions.label: ATTRIBUTE BOTH INJURIES TO THE CRASH

success: Primary entries inspected. INC-P17 and INC-G04 are the next incident-file references. The injuries predate the flight; their perpetrator is not established by these pages.
